audit_method: Compared the distributable specification against the public 46-page PDF in source order.
Used the non-distributable modernized transcription only as an auxiliary readability aid for formula recovery; it is not a repository or certificate dependency.
Required every numbered equation, named source result, counterexample, scope/sharpness claim, and mixed mathematical/open-question passage to have an explicit source atom or parent atom.
Classified every source atom against the 29-result completion boundary and recorded the counted result IDs, if any, that each atom supports; generic exclusion without a reason code is not accepted.
